description: Observed low-price RSC product search with a DPAPI-protected public browsing session. This manifest covers search only; whole-context browserless bootstrap and renewal remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Search main product cards through the maintained protected-session RSC HTTP client
capabilities.note: Use coupang-retail-session search, not coupang-public retail-search --anonymous, for this capability. Session preflight failures are not HTTP 403. Initial/rebootstrap uses the authorized browser; recurring reads and x-cp-s refresh use HTTP. The local six-hour bound remains; opaque context expiry recovery, full catalog pagination, account pricing and product detail are outside this proof.
